events.detail:
# Rollout notes

## Summary

- Fixed Level 50 normal restart so the moving lift is reconstructed from the captured checkpoint geometry before the player respawns.
- Reattached the respawned player to the checkpoint support and aligned their vertical position with the restored support frame.
- Snapped camera progress to the checkpoint's course-space position during restart, preventing the old pre-restart camera easing.
- Cleared moving-support checkpoint metadata when a normal static checkpoint is activated.

## Source inspected

- `js/Game.js`
- `js/LevelMap.js`
- `js/Player.js`
- `game_api.js`
- `levels/level 50.txt`
- `package.json`

## Source changed

- `js/Game.js`
- `js/LevelMap.js`
- `js/Player.js`

## Checks run

- `npm run build` — passed.
- `node --check js/Game.js && node --check js/LevelMap.js && node --check js/Player.js` — passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- Protected browser smoke pass at the retained Level 50 URL, including a native `R` restart after reaching the lift/checkpoint.

## Observations

- The checkpoint guide already stores lift geometry (`id`, `x`, `y`, and tile count), so the lift phase is derived from that geometry rather than saving motion-clock or camera state.
- The inverse lift phase intentionally selects the earlier half-cycle, matching the Level 50 checkpoint approach.
